# simplevm_vm (Resource)

A SimpleVM virtual machine, optionally with a research environment.

Creating a VM is asynchronous: the provider polls SimpleVM until the VM is `active` and, with a `research_environment`, until its playbook has finished. A failed playbook (`task_state = playbook_failed`) fails the apply and the VM is tainted, so the next apply replaces it. Stopping, resuming and deleting are polled the same way; see `timeouts`. If a VM created with `power_state = "stopped"` cannot be stopped, the apply only warns: the VM is kept and the next plan shows the stop as an in-place update.

`power_state` only takes `active` or `stopped` and is the only argument that can change in place; every other argument replaces the VM. While the VM is in a transient state (for example `building` or `rebooting`) a refresh does not report `power_state` drift.

Importing does not restore `research_environment`, because SimpleVM does not report it. Add `lifecycle { ignore_changes = [research_environment] }` to an imported research environment VM to keep it from being replaced.

## Example Usage

```terraform
# A VM from a base image.
resource "simplevm_vm" "base" {
  name   = "analysis"
  flavor = "de.NBI default"
  image  = "Ubuntu-22.04"
}

# A VM with an RStudio research environment, created stopped.
data "simplevm_image" "rstudio" {
  name = "RStudio-Ubuntu-22.04"
}

resource "simplevm_vm" "rstudio" {
  name   = "rstudio"
  flavor = "de.NBI default"
  image  = data.simplevm_image.rstudio.name

  research_environment = {
    template = data.simplevm_image.rstudio.resenv_template_name
  }

  power_state = "stopped"

  timeouts = {
    create = "45m"
  }
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `flavor` (String) Name of the flavor, for example `de.NBI default`; see the `simplevm_flavors` data source. Changing it replaces the VM.
- `image` (String) Name of the base image or snapshot image; see the `simplevm_images` and `simplevm_snapshot_images` data sources. Changing it replaces the VM.
- `name` (String) Name of the VM, 1 to 100 characters. SimpleVM appends a suffix to it; see `full_name`. Changing it replaces the VM, unless `full_name` is the new name plus such a suffix (for example after an import).

### Optional

- `power_state` (String) Desired power state: `active` (default) or `stopped`. Changing it stops or resumes the VM in place. Only `active` and `stopped` VM states are read back, so transient states do not cause drift.
- `project_id` (Number) ID of the SimpleVM project the VM belongs to. Defaults to the provider's `project_id`. Changing it replaces the VM.
- `research_environment` (Attributes) Research environment to install on the VM. The image must support the template (see `resenv_template_name` of the `simplevm_image` data source). Changing it replaces the VM. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--research_environment))
- `timeouts` (Attributes) Timeouts for long-running operations, as Go durations such as `30m` or `1h`. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--timeouts))

### Read-Only

- `created_at` (String) Creation time of the VM as reported by SimpleVM.
- `fixed_ip` (String) Fixed (internal) IP address of the VM.
- `full_name` (String) Name of the VM in SimpleVM: `name` plus the suffix SimpleVM appends, for example `my-vm-faaef`.
- `id` (String) UUID of the VM in SimpleVM.
- `openstack_id` (String) OpenStack ID of the VM.
- `research_environment_url` (String) URL of the research environment; empty for VMs without one.
- `task_state` (String) Current task state as reported by SimpleVM, for example `building_playbook`; empty when idle.
- `vm_state` (String) Current VM state as reported by SimpleVM, for example `active`, `stopped` or `building`.

<a id="nestedatt--research_environment"></a>
### Nested Schema for `research_environment`

Required:

- `template` (String) Name of the research environment template, for example `rstudio`.

Optional:

- `create_only` (Boolean) Install the research environment without making it reachable through the SimpleVM portal. Defaults to `false`.
- `user_path` (String) URL path under which the research environment is served. Defaults to `""`, which lets SimpleVM choose.


<a id="nestedatt--timeouts"></a>
### Nested Schema for `timeouts`

Optional:

- `create` (String) Timeout for the create operation (default `30m`). A string that can be [parsed as a duration](https://pkg.go.dev/time#ParseDuration) consisting of numbers and unit suffixes, such as "30s" or "2h45m". Valid time units are "s" (seconds), "m" (minutes), "h" (hours).
- `delete` (String) Timeout for the delete operation (default `15m`). A string that can be [parsed as a duration](https://pkg.go.dev/time#ParseDuration) consisting of numbers and unit suffixes, such as "30s" or "2h45m". Valid time units are "s" (seconds), "m" (minutes), "h" (hours). Setting a timeout for a Delete operation is only applicable if changes are saved into state before the destroy operation occurs.
- `update` (String) Timeout for the update operation (default `15m`). A string that can be [parsed as a duration](https://pkg.go.dev/time#ParseDuration) consisting of numbers and unit suffixes, such as "30s" or "2h45m". Valid time units are "s" (seconds), "m" (minutes), "h" (hours).

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
# A VM is imported by its SimpleVM UUID. research_environment is not restored
# on import; add `lifecycle { ignore_changes = [research_environment] }` to the
# resource if the VM has one.
terraform import simplevm_vm.base 3f2a9c4e-1b7d-4e8a-9c21-5d6f7a8b9c0d
```
